title: Ideaspace Thread Agreement frontmatter
description: Optional frontmatter on _threads/<thread>/_agent/agreement.md only. For new authoring, validate a parsed YAML object against this schema, not the ordinary Note schema. Since 0.33.0 the Thread's current parent is set by posts (the newest post that carries `parent`); the Agreement field is the fallback a writer keeps during the compatibility window, read as `parent` first, then the legacy `attached_to`. A reader tolerates an old malformed value, drops that field and reports invalid_parent or invalid_attached_to instead of rejecting the Agreement. A plain Markdown Agreement has no declared parent; malformed YAML is diagnosed before schema validation. PROVISIONAL, v0.33.0.

parent.description: Optional fallback parent post, written during the compatibility window: a canonical repository-root-relative post path or opaque msg_ id, with or without the post: prefix. A post's `parent` newer than the opening wins over it; it wins over the opening post, which records the immutable origin. The addressed form post:@<root>//… belongs on posts, not here. No pin is carried; see threads.md for resolution.

attached_to.description: Legacy name of `parent`, read when `parent` is absent: a canonical repository-root-relative post path or opaque msg_ id. Writers keep it beside a post's `parent` during the compatibility window and stop after it. No pin is carried here; see threads.md for resolution.

x-status: provisional and public — expect breaking changes before 1.0
